Container.Name: Stackyard
Container.Overview: A self-hosted homelab dashboard you actually want to look at.[br][br]Most dashboards are a wall of numbers and charts. Stackyard is the opposite: a calm, launcher-style grid of app tiles, folders, and a small number of genuinely useful widgets. Built to be glanced at a hundred times a day without feeling cluttered.[br][br]Everything is set up from the browser. Add app tiles, group them into folders, arrange pages, and drop in widgets for the services you already run. Widgets cover Docker, system health, downloads, media, backups, network and more.[br][br]Runs as one container with no external database and no runtime dependencies. Configuration and uploaded icons persist in the two paths below.[br][br]Note: most homelab services live on private addresses. The Allow Private IPs setting below is on by default so links and widgets pointing at your other containers work. Turn it off to keep the SSRF guard enabled.

Container.DonateText: If Stackyard is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
Container.Changes:
### 1.18.0 - 2026-10-17
### Added
- The widget picker shows a one-line description of each widget type.
- Widgets open their service when no Click URL is set, if the browser can reach its address.
- Backup, Now Playing and System Summary open the job, item or system they show, under the Click URL when one is set.
- System Summary and the Connections map have a Click URL setting.
- Add an optional API token for Scrutiny in Disk Health, needed from Scrutiny 2.0.
### Changed
- The small VPN view leaves more room between its text and the card edge.
- The VPN view no longer shows the public IP address unless Show IP Address is turned on in its settings.
- Widgets show soft placeholder shapes while they load, and Books and Now Playing no longer show a heading or "Nothing playing" before their data arrives.
- Disk Health shows each drive's status light on its bay.
- Disk Health bay tooltips use the full widget width, so drive names are cut less often.
- Widget link fields are labelled Link URL.
- Weather hover and screen-reader text include when the data was last updated.
- The Persian analog clock no longer shows the year on the dial.
### Fixed
- Weather, Books and GitHub contributions now mark their data as out of date after one failed refresh, not two.
- Disk Health names a failed drive in words instead of only turning its light red.
- The DNS widget labels its chart, so allowed, cached and blocked queries no longer rely on colour alone.
- Widget text is never smaller than 11 points, including book spines, disk bay labels, backup cards and the Now Playing band.
- Book spine titles and disk bay labels no longer shift letter by letter on hover.
- Large and extra large widgets on desktop now end level with the widgets beside them.
- Counts in search, badges and widgets follow the plural rules of the selected language.
- Backup, Now Playing, Books, Weather and Connections read their labels in the selected language's word order.
- Backup shows run times in the selected language.
- Lists use the selected language's separators.
- The language picker marks each language name with its language for screen readers.
- System Summary translates "All interfaces" and badges translate container states.
- Persian text reads as everyday Persian and no longer misdescribes several settings.
- German, Spanish, French and Chinese text reads naturally, uses one form of address, and follows each language's typography.
- Weather no longer shows dark bands at the card's sides in daytime with the dark theme.
- System Summary chart columns have equal gaps.
- Backup job names and error lines no longer break inside a word.
- The analog clock date is no longer drawn below 11px.
- Connections map legend entries have larger tap areas.
- Backup card text no longer runs past the card in Persian.
- Large Books spines show more of each title.
- Stackyard icon no longer shows blank on the Unraid Docker tab and Dashboard.
- Stop logging an nginx warning on every settings save.
- Show settings labels in full on a phone instead of cutting them off.
### Security
- Update expat to 2.9.0 to fix CVE-2026-77214 and CVE-2026-102633.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is reached on.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Dashboard configuration. Keep this, or every setting is lost on update.

Config.Name: Icon Storage
Config.Description: Icons you upload for your app tiles.

Config.Name: Allow Private IPs
Config.Description: Let widgets and badges reach private addresses, which most homelab services use. Set to false to keep the SSRF guard on.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of a Docker socket proxy, for the Docker widgets. Example: http://socket-proxy:2375

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true when running behind a reverse proxy, so client addresses are read from the forwarded headers.

Config.Name: Node Options
Config.Description: Node heap cap. Keep it near half the --memory limit in Extra Parameters, and raise both together.
